question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party and state institutions drives the 95% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Ongoing military and elite purges have concentrated authority around loyalists, eliminated potential rivals within the Central Military Commission, and reinforced top-down control ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Recent appointments and the absence of any public succession signals or credible challenges underscore this continuity, with Xi positioned to secure an additional term. While health developments, elite fragmentation, or sudden policy reversals could theoretically shift dynamics, the current structure of patronage networks and institutional dominance makes such near-term disruptions improbable.
